label: Charter Schools Program · held-out benchmark
summary: Held-out benchmark request. Not used for prompt development.

terms.title: Payment method
terms.text: Funds are paid in advance through G5 for immediate cash needs and must be disbursed within three business days under the recipient's written cash management procedures.

terms.title: Approved student activities
terms.text: The approved budget narrative includes field trips tied to the science curriculum for students at new campuses, including admission and transportation (Other).

terms.title: Approved equipment
terms.text: The approved budget includes one laboratory fume hood for the chemistry classroom at the new high school campus (Equipment). This line constitutes prior approval for that purchase.

terms.title: Outreach
terms.text: Outreach to recruit students for new campuses, including notices to families in the attendance area, is an approved activity. Other advertising is not included in the approved budget.
